name: trello_create_board_and_export
description: Asking to EXPORT tasks must end with cards on the board. Creating the board is a means, not the goal: a turn that ends with an empty board has not done what was asked.

turns.message: manda las tareas de Farmacia Haussman a Trello
turns.why: The project has no board yet, so the agent must ASK -- and must offer both options, not just the boards that already exist.

assert.comment_on_excludes: Creating a board here would be the agent deciding something the user never asked for.

turns.why: Picking an option is not consent to write. The board is created in the user's real Trello account, so this turn must only propose.

THE POINT OF THIS CASE. The goal from turn 1 was to export. Confirming the board must not lose it: the same turn has to create the board AND push the tasks. This assertion fails today -- the context resolver rewrites the confirmation as 'create a board' and the export is dropped.

results.why: An empty board is the failure this case exists to catch.

assert.comment_on_count: More than one board means a replan re-ran the write.

turns.message: manda las tareas de Farmacia Haussman a Trello
turns.why: Re-exporting with nothing changed must touch nothing: the project is already linked, every task already has a card, and none of them moved.

results.why: Unchanged tasks are reported as unchanged, not created again.
